tool.name: Biomni: Get Hpo Names
tool.description: Retrieve the names of given HPO terms.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Get Hpo Names**
Retrieve the names of given HPO terms.
Args: hpo_terms (List[str]): A list of HPO terms (e.g., ['HP:0001250']).
Returns: List[str]: A list of corresponding HPO term names.
**Domain**: database **Function**: get_hpo_names
